## Notes

- Construction Chart (SPI 24.17): per item and situation, which units may do it (builders = alternatives; units within an option work together), the supplies spent, the operations stages (or CP for dumps) and where it may happen; the chart's key and its three footnotes are restated as fields (hot_weather_extra_water, enemy_zoc_allowed, one_at_a_time). Unless a row sets enemy_zoc_allowed or rebuild_in_enemy_zoc_in, nothing is built in an enemy ZOC (chart note)
- Two printed rows pair an item's one-level rebuild with a smaller item's build at the same cost ('Air Field rebuild 1 level or Air Landing Strip build'; 'Flying Boat Basin rebuild 1 level or Flying Boat Alighting Area build'): stored as two rows each, so 16 printed rows become 18
- Chart vs rules text: the chart gives a temporary repair facility as 50 fuel + 250 stores in 1 stage and a facility rebuild as 10 fuel + 50 stores, where SPI 24.82/24.84 say 150 fuel + 250 stores over 3 stages and 30 fuel + 50 stores; the real supply dump is 10 stores here and 20 in 24.9 (rulings/R-018). Values here are the chart's, as printed
- Transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 103, printed sideways) and cross-checked against the 300 dpi community scan of the chart sheet (scan:discord:Shared Charts.pdf:p9): 0 of 16 printed rows differ. Clay Stone's errata-integrated Land rules PDF contains no chart sheet
